issues.description: catch  Basin intersection Shirley st Charles needs clean out

Yesterday around 6:15 PM there was water spewing up from a manhole or drain cover in the middle of the Dexter St/ Maple St intersection.  Water was flowing down Dexter St. from Maple to Elm filling the street above the level of the sidewalk with a current like a river.

Next to In and Out Convenience  store the sidewalk is impassable after any rain. 
The City Engineer promised to take care of this problem when they finished the Road work fixing the water pipes.  Well, this is the result. They patched along the curb but obviously they did not do it right. It does not drain to the sewer further down Swains Pond Ave. 
This has been going on here for years.  Maybe an outside consultant can rectify this problem. So sick of looking at it. Every time I walk to the store I have to walk behind the store and come out the other side.  If a car goes through it and you’re standing too close you’re going to get soaked from filthy standing water. 
Please don’t ignore this complaint  any longer. It has been way to long!!
Thank you.
